summaries.Romania: Romania lost €770M in EU recovery funds after failing to pass the wage reform law by the PNRR deadline, while infrastructure projects continue with 47km of new motorway opened. Political gridlock persists as parties debate government formation with competing proposals for governance.
summaries.Healthcare: Romania launches E-SanatateaMea platform on September 1st enabling online appointment booking with medical specialists, while healthcare innovation globally focuses on radiopharmaceuticals, mRNA vaccines, and AI integration challenges in hospital systems.
summaries.Tech: Tim Cook steps down as Apple CEO today after 15 years, with John Ternus taking over; Apple's September 9 event promises iPhone 18 Pro, Watch Series 12, AirPods 5, and the iPhone Ultra, while regulatory pressure intensifies on AI platforms like ChatGPT and Google Maps faces political pressure over naming.

items.title: Hospitals Are All In on AI, but Testing and Oversight Haven’t Caught Up
items.snippet:
A new report found that while more than 90% of health systems have deployed third-party AI tools, less than half have the infrastructure to properly test and validate them before they become embedded in patient care.

items.line: 90% of U.S. health systems deploy third-party AI tools but less than half have infrastructure to properly test and validate them before clinical deployment.
